A '''bulldozer''' was a construction vehicle. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] utilized bulldozers as part of their deforestation efforts in the [[Kinkosa rain forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]].
